subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should the operation-aware delivery resolver and QQBot reconnect drain become the approved compatibility behavior for outbound channel resolution and queued delivery replay?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes shared delivery resolution precedence and queued-message replay behavior where green CI cannot prove every existing plugin and upgrade state.

options.title: Approve current semantics
options.body: Accept the delivery-only resolver precedence and reconnect drain behavior after channel/gateway owner review, then merge once required checks are clean.

options.title: Narrow replay behavior first
options.body: Keep the resolver fix but require a smaller or more explicitly bounded reconnect drain if owners are not comfortable with replay/backoff bypass semantics.

options.title: Pause for alternate recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR if owners prefer fixing QQBot reconnect registration/bootstrap state directly instead of adding reconnect drain hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve current semantics
recommendation.body: Accept the delivery-only resolver precedence and reconnect drain behavior after channel/gateway owner review, then merge once required checks are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: frankekn is connected to both the original QQBot merge path and the central outbound registry recovery history, making them the best available owner for the cross-boundary compatibility choice.
